description: Poll a known async run or export ID; for a tracking group ID use socialseal_get_tracking_group_refresh_status. Wait pollAfterSeconds before checking again when it is returned. UUID auto ids are journey runs; numeric auto ids are AI answer runs (Google AI, ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude). Both are workspace-scoped, as are google_ai_run, journey_run, explore_run, and video_analysis. Pass the workspaceId from the lookup that returned the run. MCP-host errors such as "No approval received" occur before SocialSeal executes this tool; they are not SocialSeal billing, workspace approval, or job-status errors.

workspaceId.description: Pass the workspace from the lookup that returned this run id. Required for auto/google_ai_run/journey/explore/video polls unless the user can reach only one workspace.

balanceAfter.description: The workspace's credit balance after these charges.

chargedCredits.description: Credits charged so far for the work this result names. Work is charged once, when it succeeds.
